description: Ministry of Defence - Award of Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Services Clasp
reasoning: This gazette announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel (both officers and airmen) for completing 12 years of service. This falls under public service matters related to service conditions, awards, and recognition within the armed forces, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it involves named individuals, it does not concern government structural changes, ministerial appointments, or portfolio responsibilities that would fall under Types 1-3.
